lines.text: CardiacCycle/Heartbeat
One contraction and one relaxation of the heart is called a cardiac cycle.It makes
one heartbeat.Contraction of heart is termed as systole and relaxation as diastole
Onecompletecycletakes O.8seconds.Normal rateofheartbeat ina healthyhuman
being is 72times perminute.This is also called the heartrate.
(i)Thefirst phase iscalledsystole.It occurs when both ventricles contracttopump
the blood into pulmonary arteries and aorta.Due to this contraction, tricuspid
and bicuspid valves close and semilunar valves open.During systole“lubb"
soundisproducedduetotheclosing oftricuspidandbicuspidvalves.
(ii) The second phase is called diastole.It occurs immediately after systole when
bothatria relax so thatblood enters theatria.Duetothis,tricuspid andbicuspid
valves open and semilunar valves close..Contraction of the atria fills the
ventricles. During diastole “dubb" sound is produced due to the closing
semilunarvalves.

Pulse
Heart rate can be measured by feeling the pulse.A pulse is a series of expansion
waves in an artery caused by the contractions of the left ventricle,When the
ventricle contracts blood rushes through the arteries.The elastic walls of arteries
expand.The arteries in wrists are close to the surface.Therefore,pulsecan be felt
easilyhere.Pulserate is aneasywaytounderstandtheconditionofheart.
